default_planning_basis: About 10-mile plume pathway planning zone for large light-water power reactors; exact size and shape are site-specific.
exercise_or_validation_method: annual map/data version check plus exercise inject for sector-based protective action
hard_failure_if_missing: public instructions and protective actions route to wrong jurisdictions or populations

default_planning_basis: About 50-mile ingestion pathway planning zone; focus is food, water, milk, agriculture, livestock, fish/game and drinking-water controls.
hard_failure_if_missing: contaminated food or water pathway remains open while plume actions appear successful

default_planning_basis: EPZ demographic assumptions must remain current enough for protective-action choices.
required_data_fields: resident population;day/night population;seasonal population;schools;childcare;hospitals;long-term care;prisons;shelters;tourist loads;limited-English populations;disability/access needs;carless households
exercise_or_validation_method: demographic refresh audit and notification/transportation assistance access test
hard_failure_if_missing: evacuation/shelter models exclude people who actually need assistance

default_planning_basis: Evacuation-time estimate and route-capacity assumptions are not evergreen.
required_data_fields: route links;contraflow rules;fuel availability;traffic control points;shadow evacuation;school release;transit capacity;pet/livestock constraints;weather constraints
exercise_or_validation_method: ETE refresh;traffic-control drill;transit assistance exercise;degraded-road scenario
hard_failure_if_missing: route plan works on paper but fails under congestion, outage, or smoke/flood constraints

default_planning_basis: Sheltering-in-place is a protective action only when indoor conditions and transition rules are credible.
required_data_fields: building stock;HVAC/filtration;power outage;heat/smoke;institutional shelter capacity;reception center alternatives;transition-to-evacuation criteria
exercise_or_validation_method: shelter decision tabletop under heat/smoke/outage and public-message test
hard_failure_if_missing: shelter instruction traps people in unsafe buildings or becomes a substitute for evacuation support

default_planning_basis: Public alerting must reach people, not just devices.
required_data_fields: sirens;EAS;WEA;NOAA radio;reverse 911;door-to-door;accessible formats;language coverage;backup power;rumor monitoring
exercise_or_validation_method: multi-channel alert test with coverage, comprehension, and accessible-format checks
hard_failure_if_missing: alert system passes technical test but fails language/disability/no-phone populations

default_planning_basis: Reception centers and population monitoring need throughput, privacy, family reunification, and decontamination flows.
required_data_fields: center locations;portal/handheld monitors;staffing;PPE;decon supplies;registration/privacy;family reunification;transport;medical referral
hard_failure_if_missing: people self-disperse without monitoring, tracking, decontamination, or follow-up

default_planning_basis: Food, milk, water, livestock, agriculture and fish/game controls require legal authorities and sampling logistics before release.
required_data_fields: authority to embargo;alternate water supply;sampling locations;laboratory chain-of-custody;public-health advisories;economic support;waste pathway
exercise_or_validation_method: food/water control tabletop with lab and public-health decision timing
hard_failure_if_missing: contaminated products move before interdiction and compensation supports are ready

required_data_fields: wildfire smoke;extreme heat;flood;snow/ice;grid outage;cyber degradation;hospital surge;bridge/road outages;telecom failure
hard_failure_if_missing: plan assumes normal roads, power, air quality, staff availability, and hospitals

default_planning_basis: Cross-border and tribal coordination must be explicit where EPZs cross jurisdictions.
required_data_fields: state/local/tribal contacts;neighbor-state protocols;public-message harmonization;mutual aid;data-sharing;claims/recovery handoff
exercise_or_validation_method: joint review and cross-jurisdictional notification drill
hard_failure_if_missing: one jurisdiction acts while adjacent populations receive conflicting directions

default_planning_basis: Public maps and instructions need version control and publication-safe redaction boundaries.
required_data_fields: map version;last review date;plain-language instructions;redacted sensitive routes/facilities;counterevidence channel
exercise_or_validation_method: public scorecard audit and sample resident comprehension test
hard_failure_if_missing: public sees stale or over-redacted instructions and cannot challenge readiness claims

default_planning_basis: Emergency planning for SMR/non-LWR/NPUF facilities must branch on analyzed hazards and approved performance-based requirements, not inherit or discard large-LWR EPZ assumptions blindly.
required_data_fields: hazard analysis;EPZ boundary basis;performance objectives;quarterly metrics;drill/exercise evidence;offsite contacts where EPZ extends beyond site boundary
exercise_or_validation_method: performance-objective review and initial exercise evidence check
hard_failure_if_missing: new reactor is treated as exempt from emergency-preparedness proof or forced into irrelevant legacy assumptions
